scenario.title: 跟國外公司視訊面試
scenario.context: 外商面試時，面試官說話很精簡：「在這裡工作的人都…」「上個月推出的產品…」。英文常把關係子句減化成分詞片語（people working here、the product launched last month），聽起來專業又流暢，是 B2 聽力和口說的重要升級。

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: Thanks for joining us, Minz. Can you tell us about a project you're proud of?
lines.zh: Minz，謝謝你參加。可以說說一個你自豪的案子嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sure. Last year, I designed packaging for a tea brand based in Taichung. The designs, printed on recycled paper, won a local award.
lines.zh: 好的。去年我為一個台中的茶飲品牌設計包裝。那些印在再生紙上的設計得了一個在地獎項。

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: Impressive. Our team works with clients located all over Asia. How do you handle different time zones?
lines.zh: 很厲害。我們團隊的客戶遍布亞洲，你怎麼處理不同時區？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I set clear check-in times and use shared boards so anyone joining late can catch up.
lines.zh: 我會設定明確的對接時間，也用共享看板，讓晚加入的人都能跟上。

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: Great. Most people working here are remote. Is that something you're comfortable with?
lines.zh: 很好。在這裡工作的人大多是遠端，你習慣嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Absolutely. I've been freelancing remotely for over a year.
lines.zh: 完全沒問題，我已經遠端接案超過一年了。

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: Perfect. Do you have any questions for us?
lines.zh: 太好了。你有什麼問題要問我們嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yes. What does success look like for someone starting in this role?
lines.zh: 有。對剛接這個職位的人來說，怎樣才算成功？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Better than I expected. Honestly, I thought landing a job at an international studio was a long shot.
lines.zh: 比預期好。老實說，我本來覺得進國際工作室是癡心妄想。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: You're the real deal, though. Your portfolio speaks for itself.
lines.zh: 但你是真材實料的，你的作品集就是證明。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: They said they'll let candidates selected for the next round know by Friday.
lines.zh: 他們說週五前會通知進入下一輪的候選人。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: You'll get it. You were a rock star in that last project.
lines.zh: 你會上的。你在上個案子表現超亮眼。

patterns.en: One project I'm particularly proud of is ___.
patterns.zh: 我特別自豪的一個案子是 ___。

patterns.en: I'm used to working across time zones.
That's a great question. Let me think for a second.
What does success look like in this role?
patterns.zh: 這個職位怎樣才算成功？

patterns.en: What are the next steps in the process?
I look forward to hearing from you.

chinglish.wrong: The people who are working here are remote.
chinglish.right: The people working here are remote.
chinglish.why: 文法沒錯，但減化成分詞片語更簡潔自然。

chinglish.wrong: The designs which printed on recycled paper won an award.
chinglish.right: The designs printed on recycled paper won an award.
chinglish.why: 設計是「被印」的，要嘛用 which were printed，要嘛減化成 printed。which printed 會變成設計去印東西。

chinglish.wrong: Sorry my English is not good, I will try my best.
chinglish.why: 複習第 51 單元：面試開頭不要為英文道歉。
any 後面接可數名詞用複數。

grammar.title: 減化關係子句
grammar.oneLiner: who / which / that + be 動詞 可以省略：主動改成 V-ing，被動直接用 p.p.。
whenToUse: 主動（進行）：people who are working here → people working here。
主動（一般）：anyone who joins late → anyone joining late。
被動：the product that was launched last month → the product launched last month。
被動：a brand that is based in Taichung → a brand based in Taichung。
形容詞片語：a room that is full of people → a room full of people。
判斷方法：名詞是「做」動作用 V-ing，名詞是「被」做用 p.p.。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的修飾語放在名詞前面（在這裡工作的人），英文放後面，這點第 31 單元學過。減化關係子句又更進一步：去掉 who / which 和 be 動詞。台灣人最常見的錯誤是 which printed（該用被動卻用主動），因為中文「印在再生紙上的設計」看不出主動被動。

Products made in Taiwan are known for quality.
Anyone interested in the role should apply by Friday.
The email sent this morning had a typo.
Designers using AI tools can work faster.

The app ___ last month already has a million users.
quiz.explanation: app 是被推出的，用 p.p.。

Which is correct?
options: The report which written by Amy is great.
The report written by Amy is great.
The report writing by Amy is great.

slang.usage: 成功得到（通常不容易得到的）工作、客戶、機會。land a client / land a deal。

examples.en: She landed a job at Google right after graduation.
examples.zh: 她一畢業就拿下 Google 的工作。

examples.en: We finally landed that big client!
examples.zh: 我們終於拿下那個大客戶了！

slang.usage: 成功機率很低，但還是值得一試。It's a long shot, but…

examples.en: It's a long shot, but I applied anyway.
examples.zh: 機會渺茫，但我還是申請了。

examples.en: Getting tickets now is a long shot.
examples.zh: 現在要買到票機會很低。

slang.usage: 形容人或東西真的很厲害、不是虛有其表。

examples.en: This beef noodle soup is the real deal.
examples.zh: 這碗牛肉麵是真材實料的。

examples.en: She's the real deal. Her work is incredible.
examples.zh: 她是真正有實力的人，作品超厲害。

slang.meaning: （職場）超級厲害的人、明星員工
slang.usage: 稱讚某人表現非常出色：You're a rock star!

risk.note: 正面稱讚；職缺寫 rock star developer 有些人覺得很浮誇。

examples.en: Thanks for staying late. You're a rock star.
examples.zh: 謝謝你留下來加班，你太猛了。

examples.en: Our new designer is a total rock star.
examples.zh: 我們的新設計師超級厲害。

review.question: Not only ___ great benefits, but they also offer remote work.
review.explanation: 複習第 81 單元：Not only + 助動詞 + 主詞。

review.question: A: Aren't you nervous? B: (你會緊張) ___
review.explanation: 複習第 80 單元：事實是肯定就說 Yes。

review.question: My internet is ___ cutting out during calls! (老是)
review.explanation: 複習第 78 單元：always + 進行式。

review.question: I was ___ nervous before the interview.
___ experience is more important than degrees in design.
review.explanation: 複習第 66 單元：泛指不加冠詞。

review.question: The interviewer ___ read my portfolio. She mentioned details.
review.explanation: 複習第 50 單元：推測過去。

review.question: The final decision will be ___ (make) by Friday.
The logo ___ by our team won an award.
